name: matrix
description: Answer questions over large PDF and document folders up to 3× faster than Claude Code alone, with citations to file, page and passage. Local semantic search that also finds paraphrases, scans and charts, follows cross-references between provisions, and builds tables across documents. Claude Code walks you through the setup; no extra model needed.

folders.title: More folders Claude may read (optional)
folders.description: Optional. Matrix reads the folder you start Claude Code in; for any other folder it asks you first, so you normally set nothing here. Absolute paths of folders to always allow (not your whole home folder), several separated by commas; a folder name must not contain a comma. Matrix reads files there, including subfolders, and never changes or deletes them.

embedding_model.title: Search model
embedding_model.description: The model that makes your documents searchable by meaning: embeddinggemma-2 (default, multilingual, also charts and scans; about 1.2 GB from Hugging Face, downloaded once after you agree), embeddinggemma-2-q4 (0.2 GB, text only), onnx-folder:/absolute/path (a model folder you already have) or endpoint:https://host/v1#model-name (your own OpenAI-compatible embedding service; your document text is then sent to it). Changing it later only affects new collections.

embedding_api_key.title: Embedding endpoint API key (optional)
embedding_api_key.description: Only for an endpoint: search model whose service requires a key. Leave empty otherwise.
